title: Sesame Herb Hummus with Crudites
steps: Blend the drained chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, sea salt, and olive oil until smooth, loosening with cold water.
Pulse the parsley through at the end, so the dip stays flecked rather than green.
Cut the carrots, cucumber, and bell pepper into sticks, trim the snap peas, and serve alongside.
goldenRuleCallouts: Sesame paste gives this its body, so it needs no tree-nut cream of any kind.
Raw vegetables carry the dip, which keeps a processed cracker out of the snack rotation.
storageNotes: Refrigerate the dip up to 4 days under a thin film of olive oil, which keeps the surface from drying out. Cut the vegetables the day they are eaten so they stay crisp.
